notes.title: Update 0.165a: Swamp Biome! Bug fixes, performance optimizations
notes.content:
Hey all, I've been trying to finish the Cultist update to go along with the Swamp biome but there's some bug fixes I wanted to push out asap so I'm just releasing the swamp biome separately. The Cultist Faction is coming along nicely, more on that below after update notes:

New Features:
- Swamp Biome! In this damp, dark environment, food spoils faster, but you can plant all year round. Diseases are a bit more of a problem here. 
- New tameable animals: Hippos and Water Buffalos
- There's more but I can't really remember right now cause I'm too sleepy trying to push this update out as fast as I could

Bug fixes: 
- There was a bad one where a colonist death would upset a whole town too much
- Some translation errors

Performance Optimizations!

Anyway, the Cultist faction serves the Dormant God, Arkhan. They are led by Lich-Priests, who can animate the dead and recharge them with their mana. These Lich-Priests need to recharge in specialized sarcophagi, tended to by cultists and ghouls, the reanimated dead. 

Overall it's shaping up to be a whole new flavor of playing the game. Doing some further testing / polishing so it's as fun as it can be when it comes out. Shouldn''t take too long, sometime in early October. 

Thanks to everyone playing and supporting the game!

notes.title: The Construction Update - v0.13
notes.content:
Hey all, I made the building system more robust and optimized it. Previously, after building a few good sized buildings you would notice a slowdown - this update aims to address this. 
I changed some model graphics for the 'rough wood' series of buildings. New rough stairs and roofs. Check them out!
I fixed that nasty, nasty getting stuck at 23:50 bug. If it's still there somehow, please let me know! It was related to the spoilage of food. 
Improved some UI stuff! Food freshness is now color coded. Added some quick Combat Skills info when you're equipping your characters. 
Added a Customize Face selection buttons for the character creator. Zoomed it in a little. Added a ship in the background. (hint hint?)
Anyway, I've been really enjoying improving and tightening existing features and makings things more and more fun. After this, most likely working on making characters more controllable - sleep, eat, talk to people, etc. I'll keep you all updated (literally)
And please, if you're enjoying the game, please give me a quick review, it helps a LOT! If you have some complaints, please let me know in the discussion board or on discord. Thank you all!

notes.title: The Level-Up Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, this is a hefty, wide-reaching update aimed at making the game more fun, and improving and solidfying a lot of the features I've added since early access. I've been busy pushing out all the major feature updates, so this update was nice, just sitting down and actually playing and seeing how the game currently plays! I've made a lot of rebalances here and there: Crafting, Research, Relationships. Trees now work better, better combat balancing, more dynamic population growth, a revamped skill system, and many more!

- Population growth system: having a lot of food in storage, along with happy citizens, will attract new settlers to your town. 'Free' growth slows down as the town gets bigger
- Revamped skill system: better visual indicators as to when and how your citizens are leveling up
- Added the Pear tree and fruit; along with an overall fixing of the Tree plots. Generally speaking, trees require a longer growing time but then need less tending, and only produce fruit during certain seasons
- Bug fixes, can't remember which ones but there was a lot
- Performance improvements across the board

Hope you all enjoy it! Please review the game if you do!

notes.title: The Character Creator, Dynasty and Family Update
notes.content:
I don't even know where to begin with these update notes! This past month has been a blur of coding, testing, coding and testing, and here we are: 
- Create your own Character! Your character starts out as the Dynasty Leader in your new game
- Create your Dynasty! You can build dynastic heraldry under Decorations > Art
- At start, you arrive to your first settlement site with 2 of your siblings who derive looks and some stats from your created character. You have to make sure to set an Heir, under the Dynasty tab
- You can now have babies! These babies derive their looks and stats from their parents
- Characters now grow and age faster! I think this will give the game a more dynamic feel where you see generations of characters growing and passing the baton as time goes by
- Dwarves! This new race is strong, stout, and get a bonus to their crafting and endurance
- Alarm bells! Build these, under Utility > Misc, to automatically ring and call young children, visitors and traders, unarmed and heavily wounded citizens
- Improved relationship and family dynamics. People who are close to each other tend to talk more to each other, but sometimes they feel friendlier and talk to other people too
- Performance improvements
- Bug Fixes (especially creature raising related)
- And a lot more I'm probably forgetting

notes.title: Update 0.038 - Bar Counters and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
I'm in the process of upgrading the Visitor / Shop system in the game to give the game a more fun and solid shopkeeping system. Sort of fleshing it out to where, you almost have these semi-daily visitors to your settlement, buying stuff, interacting, if you choose to. I've added some tavern counters and a barstool along with some wall hanging decorations. 

The Merchant Table also now blends seamlessly with the tavern counters - it also now displays a radius and connections to nearby storage items. For the next update, guests and traders will now stand by the merchant counter, wait for an available citizen to help, and then the cashier-citizen will get their order from the nearby storage unit. Neat huh? So it will be like an actual shop or tavern. I'm pretty excited by this cause that means we can have a nice, fully immersive tavern sim too with our other Outland Kingdoms systems and combat..

Combat pace has also been lowered so you're not getting attacked continuously, along with some important bug fixes: 
- Automatically un-stucking characters stuck on, say, a roof

- Optimizations and other bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.35: The Story Brain and Event Update Part 1
notes.content:
The biggest change in this update is the completely revamped Story Brain system. Instead of using simple countdown timers, the new system actively monitors your colony's performance and dynamically serves events based on how well your settlement is doing - either helping struggling colonies or challenging successful ones.

Enemies also now interact with doors more intelligently, attacking locked doors efficiently while allowing colonists to move through during sieges. Most animals (except for bears) now don't attack buildings, circling around your settlement instead.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed farming system issues
Resolved problems with moving crafting stations
Corrected AI pathing around doors
Addressed loading issues
Reduced "stuck" behaviors and improved optimization

I've also added several new events and enemy types to take advantage of the new Story Brain system. I will be creating more events and polishing the new ones I just put out.

The next update will focus on expanding content with new furniture, building options, weapons, and equipment. Thank you for your continued bug reports - they're essential for improving the game. While this update fixes many issues, new ones may appear due to the significant system changes. Now that I'm back to working on smaller, more bite sized update, I can return to my usual rapid response to bug reports.

notes.title: 0.033 Pathfinding and Performance Update
notes.content:

After this, I will be working on a fairly large content update, along with important bug fixes and QoL. This is preparatory to me working on the World System, so players can have a lot of fun new things to play with while I hunker down and work on it.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update 0.031 - Orders, Commands and Building in Pause Mode
notes.content:
Nothing super exciting but this required an overhaul of a good amount of underlying code, to uncouple orders, commands and building placement from regular time. I like that bugs are getting fewer and farther in between and a lot of the Quality of Life issues are becoming ironed out. 

Next up, I'm going to be adjusting the underlying saving system to prepare for implementation of the World Map.

notes.title: Major Combat Updates, Part One - New Features and Improvements
notes.content:
I'm focusing on making the core gameplay tighter in preparation for the mega battle of 'World Map Building.' There's a lot of different things I worked on for this update  - the most visible are Formations (drag and hold right click to automatically array your commanded citizens), and also the new Training equipment under Military > Training. It also an actual Work Assignment so you might have to set it in the Settlement panel, for existing savegames. 

New Features:
- Smarter AI positioning. They evaluate the best way to coordinate with whoever's attacking with them (they flank and try to backstab) and avoid blobbing. I'm still improving the combat behaviors so they will keep on getting better from here
- Formations! Drag a group of your citizens in command mode and they will assume formations: melee in front, ranged in the back. I plan to expand more on this where, every unit grouping (1-9) can be assigned its own formation type (melee front archer back, vice versa, or archer at the wings, etc)
- Better AI tactics. AI now has a "general" that coordinates tactics - it splits attack groups into different squads working together to flank and maneuver
- Rotate buildings to be placed by holding mouse down
- Melee and Ranged dummies for your people to practice on (and improve their skills)
- Updated tutorials to reflect these recent features

notes.title: Patch 0.23 - Combat Targeting, Fire, Rebalanced Potatoes
notes.content:
Changes:
- Every cooking task now produces multiple cooked servings. No more spending 2 hours cooking 1 (one) potato
- Not cooking stuff that needs to be cooked now has steeper penalties. Sadness, stomach aches
- Improved targeting during combat. Enemies will now be more easy to target
- Relaxed combat and story settings are now more relaxed
- Rebalanced the fire system. Campfires may cause fires if around flammable objects

- Bug fixes

notes.title: Mini Patch: 0.221 Furnace + Other advanced crafting stations
notes.content: - Fixed an issue where furnaces didn't work. Your citizens may take a couple trips hauling the iron ore into the furnace but they will start working once they have enough. Thank you to those who reported the bug!

notes.title: Update 0.22! New Memories and Sentiments System + bug fixes
notes.content:
- NEW! Memories and Sentiments system! The way the system works is, it tracks things that happens during the life of your characters. You can turn off seeing their 'thoughts' as they arise, but I think it provides a good way to see how your settlement and its inhabitants are doing. I plan to make good use of the memory system to further make every character unique, with their own goals, memories, and even behaviors depending on their in-game life
- Tasks now being saved properly
- Options now saving properly, along with two new options settings: Edge Scrolling and Sentiments displaying
- Own creatures and agents no longer attacking player-owned buildings when locked in
- Optimized more when when on ultra-speed (while sleeping)
- Currently working on controls so it can be entirely playable with mouse only

Note: This patch may affect current savegames as I am working on a character memory system, where they remember things that happen to them. Probably not gonna be in this patch yet but it's going to be in an upcoming mini-update, either tonight or tomorrow.

Thanks to everyone playing and supporting the game!

notes.title: Patch 0.01h
notes.content:
Bug fixes and upgrades:
- butchering most animals now drop leather (they should be dropping bones too but don't have any bone-related items yet. I'm thinking of fertilizer or bone armor / weapons? Necromancer stuff?
- Pathing issues hopefully removes the 'teleporting' and jumpiness you may see from time to time especially on hills. Working on refining pathing even more. Can never polish it too much in a game like this
- Terrain optimization. Game now hides terrain when you're not looking at it on the camera. Please let me know if this slows down or improves your FPS!

Currently still working on:
- Settlement / Work Assignment screen
- Creature models overlapping sometimes (when you see 8 legged animals yep this is that)
- Also looking into weird combat behavior
- Item storage issues

Thank you to everyone for playing and supporting the game, I really appreciate it! Doing my best to fix bugs as they appear, some take longer to fix but I 100% guarantee I'm gonna iron them out!

notes.title: Update 0.01b! Faster Fast Forward, Ultra Fast Forward while Sleeping
notes.content:
Making the game snappier, more responsive. Complete list of changes:
- Spacebar to Pause game. Pause is now fully paused when using
- Edge scrolling off for now. I will bring back it back as a toggle-able option! 
- Fast Forward is now 4x faster than regular speed, up from 3x
- Ultra Fast Speed is 10x faster than regular speed. This triggers when all player-owned humanoids are sleeping
- Agents now act like polite citizens and move a little to their own left so the other agent can pass. Note to self for a future update: should also make a little bowing animation for polite characters or maybe hat tipping for hat wearers
- Fixed guidebook text
- Fixed resource list popping out at start
